title:
POV: I BROUGHT TOYS TO SICK KIDS IN ISRAEL
AND MET A FAMILY FROM RAMALLAH
beats: 'We heard your baby is not feeling well, so we wanted to give you a gift.' 'This is for you. Assalamualaikum.'
'What's your daughter's name? How long has she been sick?' 'Just today.' 'I hope she feels better.'
'Where are you guys from?' 'I'm from Palestine.' 'You're from Ramallah?' 'Amazing.'
'You came here for healthcare?' 'Yes.' 'You can come from the West Bank into Israel to get healthcare?' 'Yes - first time.'
THE ENDING: 'At the end of the day we're all human beings. We all deserve health. I'm Jewish and you're Muslim - we're brothers.'
